wechat.title: 企业 AI 落地，不止于模型
wechat.caption: 如果你也在做企业 AI 落地，可以看看这份 FDEBOK 手册。它把从场景发现、现场勘察，到方案验证、上线运维和复用沉淀的工作梳理成一套方法。涵盖 22 章、十大知识域、六阶段交付和现场模板，适合 FDE、AI 工程师及交付团队参考。
wechat.story: 从场景发现、现场勘察到方案验证、上线运维与经验复用，按交付过程梳理 FDE 在真实业务中的关键工作。
wechat.audience: 适合 FDE、AI 工程师、交付团队及技术负责人。

douyin.title: 模型演示之后，怎样走到真实交付？
douyin.caption: AI 项目从 Demo 到上线，要补齐哪些环节？FDEBOK 把场景判断、现场约束、方案验证、质量评测和运行交接串成一条交付路径。共 22 章、十大知识域和现场模板，适合做企业 AI 的朋友参考。
douyin.story: 从业务场景和现场约束出发，经过方案验证、质量评测、上线运行与交接，看看 AI 项目走向真实使用需要哪些工作。
douyin.audience: 给正在推进企业 AI 项目的工程师、产品与交付团队。

facebook.title: From AI capability to business outcomes
facebook.caption: FDEBOK is a practical guide to taking enterprise AI beyond the model demo: finding valuable use cases, working through real-world constraints, validating solutions, and operating them responsibly. Explore 22 chapters, ten knowledge domains, six delivery stages, and field templates.
facebook.story: Enterprise AI delivery is a team effort across discovery, engineering, evaluation, launch, and operations. FDEBOK organizes that work into a practical body of knowledge for Forward Deployed Engineers and the teams around them.
facebook.audience: For FDEs, AI engineers, product teams, and enterprise delivery leaders.

linkedin.title: A field guide to enterprise AI delivery
linkedin.caption: FDEBOK is a practical framework for enterprise AI delivery: ten knowledge domains, six delivery stages, an L1–L5 competency model, 20 common challenges, and nine field templates. It focuses on measurable outcomes, real-world constraints, and responsible production operations.
linkedin.story: A structured reference for teams turning enterprise AI capabilities into reliable, measurable business outcomes—from problem discovery through production operations and reuse.
linkedin.audience: For FDEs, engineering managers, AI delivery leads, and product organizations.
